meta.feature_engineering: trace-track inputs only: the harness's shared 5-s block means (bake.block_means rule: 8 channel means + mean v^2, mean v^3, summed positive kinetic-energy increment per unit mass) + the block's valid-second fraction -> 12 scaled channels; spec (49) and rl (5, logs of mass / CdA / Crr) standardised with train-bank statistics; log distance and log duration from the trace; chunks of <= 1,440 blocks mean-pooled for longer traces; anchor r0 = sim-train median MJ/km per (architecture, class) (bake.dumb_rates) x distance; from r1: E_phys recomputed from the trace inputs by bake.e_phys_from_trace (EnergyNet's generic road-load estimate; declared), target log(y / E_phys), log(E_phys / A0) as an input
